messages:
acme-integration: Hey team — heads up, after the model update this morning our integration is getting responses that don't match our JSON schema anymore. We rely on strict structured output for billing automation. Example: we send the same prompt as before and previously got a strict JSON object, now we sometimes get unquoted keys / trailing commentary and missing fields. This started ~2026-02-25T12:40Z. Request ID: rq_9a7bcf. Please escalate, this is breaking invoices. P1 :exclamation:

elaine-cs: Sorry to hear that — we'll take this P1. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) + the expected schema and the raw response you got? Also which model / variant are you hitting? We'll pull logs and check rollout timeline. :eyes:

acme-integration: Repro below. We call the generation endpoint with response_schema enforcement header (we used that previously). Sample request:

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-***" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"rwd-large-2.4",
    "prompt":"Generate invoice JSON for order 12345 with items and totals",
    "response_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"},"price":{"type":"number"}}},"total":{"type":"number"}}}
  }'
```

Expected (previously):
```
{"invoice_id":"12345","items":[{"sku":"ABC-1","qty":2,"price":19.99}],"total":39.98}
```

Actual (current):
```
{invoice_id: 12345, items: [ { sku: ABC-1, qty: 2 } ], subtotal: "39.98" } // plus a trailing line: "Note: verified"
```

This is causing our parser to fail. We used response_schema and previously it guaranteed valid JSON. :frowning:

devon-eng: Thanks — that raw response makes it obvious schema enforcement didn't hold. Do you have the full response headers including x-request-id/x-model-version? Also can you confirm frequency (is it all requests or ~some fraction)?

acme-integration: Headers when we saw it:
```
x-request-id: rq_9a7bcf
x-model: rwd-large-2.4
x-server-time: 2026-02-25T12:41:02Z
```

Happens on ~15% of requests after the rollout time window. Before rollout <0.5%.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: rwd-large-2.4 -> production canary at 2026-02-25T12:30Z by build b-20260225-14. Canary completed 2026-02-25T12:38Z. :gear:

kai-ml: I'm on it. Quick check against canary eval logs shows structured-output/schema-failure rate jump from 0.4% -> 9.3% right after the push. We changed the decoding constraints (punctuation penalty + relaxed end-seq bias) which likely improved free-text metrics but worsened strict JSON adherence for certain prompts. I'll pull the failing examples. :mag_right:

irina-product: Prioritize rollback decision. This impacts billing pipelines for a customer. If we can roll back quickly we should. Devon, can ops rollback rwd-large-2.3 globally? What's the risk? :triage_flag:

devon-eng: We can revert the model to rwd-large-2.3 in prod within ~10m. Need an explicit approval from product/CS. Before rollback, I'll try a quick mitigation: enable strict-json enforcement path (server-side) per-request for this customer to see if that blocks broken outputs. Can you share account id so we can enable it for them? Also grabbing logs for rq_9a7bcf now.

acme-integration: Account ID: acct-88a. Please enable any temporary fix. Rollback ok for us if it prevents more broken invoices.

elaine-cs: Confirming P1 ticket: CS-2026-1047. I've notified account execs and legal. Please proceed with mitigation + rollback if needed. Keep me posted on timeline.

kai-ml: Dug into a few failing tokens. Example failure shows model emitting unquoted keys and a stray English sentence appended. Looks like the new decoding schedule increases chance of emitting control tokens outside the JSON fences for short structured prompts. Short-term mitigation: force the model into our strict-json decoding mode (decode.strict_json=true) which enforces token-level constraints for JSON tokens. If ops can flip that for acct-88a or at a per-request level that should reduce failures to baseline. Longer-term we should revert decoding change or add extra training/eval for structured prompts.

devon-eng: I've enabled decode.strict_json for acct-88a at 2026-02-25T12:58:10Z. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: decode.strict_json=true for acct-88a (ff-9134) by devops at 2026-02-25T12:58:11Z.

acme-integration: After the flag flip, we retried and the JSON looks correct on our sample. Thanks — still would like rollback though until a full post-mortem. :pray:

kai-ml: Quick metric after enabling strict_json for that account: schema-failure for their traffic dropped from ~15% -> 0.6% within 5 minutes. However global traffic still shows 9% regression overall on canary. I'm recommending rollback of rwd-large-2.4 until we fix the decoding schedule and expand structured-output evals.

irina-product: Approve global rollback. Please schedule ASAP and include customer-facing note.

devon-eng: Rolling back rwd-large-2.3 -> production now. I'll post rollback confirmation when complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Rollback executed: rwd-large-2.3 restored to production at 2026-02-25T13:05:12Z by ops (rollback-b-20260225-14). Canary instances drained. :white_check_mark:

devon-eng: Post-rollback sanity check: re-sent their sample request using production endpoint and got the expected JSON matching their schema. Attached logs: x-request-id rq_9a7cf2, x-model rwd-large-2.3, response body valid JSON.

acme-integration: Confirmed on our side — invoices are back to normal. Appreciate the fast action, thank you everyone. We'll stay on the strict_json flag off if needed but happy to drop it once you release a fixed rwd-large-2.4 candidate.

elaine-cs: Customer notified and P1 ticket updated. Next steps: ML to root cause and add structured-output tests to the canary gate; Eng to add a deploy check that monitors schema-failure rate and auto-halts rollout if threshold exceeded (suggest 1%). Kai/Devon please collaborate and produce RCA and remediation plan by EOD tomorrow. I'll schedule a postmortem invite. :calendar:

kai-ml: Acknowledged — I'll prepare the eval artifacts and failing examples. Early hypothesis: decoding schedule change increased entropy near brace tokens. We'll try a constrained decode fix + targeted regen logs for structured prompts.

devon-eng: Will add alerting on schema-failure rate and a canary gate check. Also documenting the emergency rollback playbook in runbook. PR linked in ticket.

deploy-bot: Incident closed for now: P1 handled, rollback completed at 2026-02-25T13:05:12Z. Follow-up tasks assigned.

acme-integration: Thanks again, team. Please keep us posted when a safe rwd-large-2.4 is available and we'll coordinate testing on our side.
